description: Add the four read-only job delegates the annotation→KG Publisher needs (issue #16, Track B1): list_jobs, get_job, list_job_transitions and get_graph on AgencyAnnotationsClient, plus AnnotationJobSummary/AnnotationJob/JobTransitionEntry and their paged wrappers. Mirrors each endpoint's own query-param names rather than normalising them (jobs use o/p/s, transitions use organisation/page/size), keeps annotation_data/checklist_state/delta opaque because their shape is owned by whichever front-end wrote them, and carries the PHI never-log warning on transition notes. Read-only by design: the Publisher never writes to comand. Zero comand changes; rc16 is cut separately once the consuming track's Gate A signs off.
